LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod.description: A floor-mounted, pre-fueled single-use escape pod designed to evacuate one colonist with whatever gear they carry. It launches immediately after the crewmember enters and descends directly to the surface. Must be placed on Hellion deck plating. Only works in orbit.
LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyGenerator.label: emergency Hellion generator
LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyGenerator.description: An emergency power source capable of fully powering a Hellion by adjusting its output to match demand. It should be reserved for emergencies, as maximum output always causes a critical breakdown and EMP detonation. It can produce up to 50,000 W/d before breaking down.
LanguageData.VGE_GravlaunchCloaker.description: A specialized device that masks the energy signature of a Hellion launch, reducing the visibility it generates and making the Hellion less likely to be detected.\n\nA Hellion can support two gravlaunch cloakers.
LanguageData.VGE_Gravmine.description: A high-explosive device designed for orbital combat. Its large detection radius triggers a powerful blast when any target approaches, including enemy Hellions. It can only be constructed in space.
LanguageData.VGE_Warcomputer.description: The tactical supercomputer core of a Hellion. It enhances the aircraft's weapons and defenses: gauss artillery becomes more accurate, javelin missiles fire faster, anticraft beam weapons fire longer bursts, and point defense turrets intercept projectiles at greater distances. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_GravFieldDilutor.description: An advanced device that dramatically increases the size of a Hellion but weakens its lift field slightly, decreasing the amount of deck plating it can support. Must be built near a Hellion engine.\n\nA Hellion can support only one grav field dilutor.
LanguageData.VGE_AstrofireLauncher.description: A compact multi-tube missile platform that fires four rapid astrofuel warheads, igniting the impact area. Intended for fast strikes against exposed Hellions and unarmored surface forces, it requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator and draws power directly from the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipArmor.label: Hellion armor
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipArmor.description: A heavily reinforced airtight wall designed to withstand extreme impacts and hostile fire in vacuum. It connects directly to the underlying deck structure and can only be built on a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_SmallElectricThruster.description: An electric thruster that increases a Hellion's range. It must be fully charged before use. Unlike astrofuel thrusters, electric thrusters do not increase maximum deck size, but their low energy footprint reduces the visibility generated during travel. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and Hellion deck plating. A Hellion can support up to ten small thrusters.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeElectricThruster.description:
An advanced electric thruster with a heat-resistant vacstone liner. It must be fully charged before use. Unlike astrofuel thrusters, electric thrusters do not increase maximum deck size, but their low energy footprint reduces the visibility generated during travel. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and Hellion deck plating.

Requires vacstone blocks, which can be obtained from orbital asteroids.

A Hellion can support up to six large thrusters.
LanguageData.VGE_GiantElectricThruster.description:
A massive reinforced electric thruster built with advanced alloys and ultra-dense vacstone plating. It must be fully charged before use. Unlike astrofuel thrusters, electric thrusters do not increase maximum deck size, but their low energy footprint reduces the visibility generated during travel. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and Hellion deck plating.

Requires vacstone blocks, which can be obtained from orbital asteroids.

A Hellion can support up to four giant thrusters.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBombardmentTargeter.label: Hellion bombardment targeter
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBombardmentTargeter.descript: A compact targeting apparatus tuned to interface with Hellion artillery systems. When activated, it designates a ground position and transmits firing coordinates to a linked Hellion turret within range. The turret will automatically fire on the marked location. After a short cooldown, the targeter can be used again.
LanguageData.VGE_Warpod_HighExplosive.description: A launchable sub-orbital missile pod designed to deliver a high-explosive payload at extreme speed. Its velocity prevents interception by point defense, allowing it to penetrate and detonate inside enemy Hellions and orbital stations. Explodes when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Warpod_EMP.description: A launchable sub-orbital missile pod designed to deliver a powerful electromagnetic pulse at extreme speed. Its velocity prevents interception by point defense, allowing it to penetrate enemy Hellions and orbital stations and temporarily disable electronics. Explodes when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Warpod_Incendiary.description: A launchable sub-orbital missile pod designed to deliver a massive astrofuel payload at extreme speed. Its velocity prevents interception by point defense, allowing it to penetrate enemy Hellions and orbital stations and unleash a large astrofuel explosion. Explodes when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Warpod_Antigrain.description: A launchable sub-orbital missile pod designed to deliver a devastating antimatter payload at extreme speed. Its velocity prevents interception by point defense, allowing it to penetrate enemy Hellions and orbital stations and obliterate the target area. Explodes when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Exoworm.description: A large genetically engineered worm-like insectoid adapted to survive in vacuum. Once the worker caste of an artificial ecosystem designed to fight robot invasions, it is now often encountered without its deadlier insectoid cousins. Its size and rapidly regenerating body make it a durable and dangerous foe. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.
